name: Named Entity Recognition
learningObjectives: Understand named entity recognition and its applications
Learn how to identify and classify named entities in text
Explore pattern-based and gazetteer-based entity extraction
Understand entity types: persons, organizations, locations, dates, etc.
Learn how to evaluate NER systems with precision, recall, and F1-score
